title: The Schema Coherence Inventory: Measuring Whether an Assigned Belief Organizes a Language Model's Cognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.31683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persona-conditioned language models are used as simulated patients and affective agents, but there is no validated way to ask whether a belief assigned to such a model organizes its behaviour or whether the model has merely adopted a mood. We present the Schema Coherence Inventory (SCI): 96 forced-choice items at eight levels of Beck's cognitive model, each offering six replies keyed to three negative self-schemas and their positive counterparts, scored by length-normalized log-likelihood so that nothing is generated or parsed. Affect alone can move a model onto a default belief, so the discriminant criterion is target specificity: a condition built for one belief must select that belief more often than conditions built for the other beliefs of its pole. Six validation studies over 107 conditions on five backbones (1.7B-14B parameters) support this reading. Nine clinically trained raters recover the keyed belief at 79.5% (chance 16.7%).

translated_title: 图式连贯性量表：测量被赋予的信念是否组织了语言模型的认知
translated_abstract: 人格条件化的语言模型被用作模拟患者和情感代理，但目前尚无经过验证的方法来判断赋予此类模型的信念是否真正组织了其行为，还是该模型仅仅采纳了一种情绪。我们提出了图式连贯性量表（SCI）：包含96个强制选择题项，覆盖贝克认知模型的八个层面，每个题项提供六个选项，分别对应三种消极自我图式及其积极对应图式，并通过长度归一化的对数似然进行评分，因此无需生成或解析任何文本。由于单纯的情感就可能使模型转向一个默认信念，判别标准是目标特异性：为某一信念构建的条件必须比为其同极性其他信念构建的条件更频繁地选中该信念。在五个骨干模型（参数量为17亿至140亿）上开展的六项验证研究、共107个条件，支持了这一解读。九名接受过临床培训的评分者能以79.5%的准确率识别出所标注的信念（随机水平为16.7%）。
tldr: 本文提出图式连贯性量表（SCI），一种基于贝克认知模型的96题强制选择、无生成评分工具，用于验证赋予语言模型的信念是否真正组织其认知而非仅仅引发情绪，并通过目标特异性判别标准在五个骨干模型上得到验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Schema Coherence Inventory (SCI), a 96-item forced-choice, log-likelihood-scored instrument that tests whether an assigned belief genuinely organizes a language model's cognition rather than merely inducing a mood, validated across five backbones using a target-specificity criterion.
